description.value: Hayat Supermarket is a retail grocery store located in Richmond, BC, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a full supermarket. Its position along Number 1 Road places it on a route accessible to cyclists travelling through the Richmond area. Touring cyclists would find it a potential stop for provisioning along this flat, cycling-friendly corridor.

The Facebook page URL was technically fetched but returned a 'Temporarily Blocked' access denial, yielding no usable website content — so all amenity and contact verification relies solely on OSM tags. No phone, email, or additional detail tags are present in OSM, leaving most fields unverifiable.
concerns: Facebook page returned a 'Temporarily Blocked' access denial — no website content was retrievable. All amenity fields other than Basic groceries remain unverified.
